label: GITHUB / CAUSAL AUDIT
title: A Behavioural-Economics Read of Bank Marketing Data
short: When prediction is not the same thing as a lever.
description: A causal and machine-learning audit of bank telemarketing data that compares predictive modelling with causal reasoning, then stress-tests the story using placebo runs, negative controls and sensitivity checks.
why: Shows the ability to move from 'what predicts conversion?' to 'what could actually change behaviour?'

label: GITHUB / PRODUCT CONCEPT
title: NudgeDesigner
short: Diagnose the behavioural mechanism before rewriting the message.
description: An AI-enabled behavioural audit and decision-support concept that evaluates why campaigns, policies and messages fail to translate awareness into action.
why: Applies COM-B and EAST thinking to behavioural friction, trust, social norms, accessibility and local context, with redesigns tailored to African audiences.

label: GITHUB / DEVELOPMENT DATA
title: Water Access Portfolio
short: A global development question made legible through data.
description: Analysis of WHO/UNICEF JMP drinking-water access data across 213 countries, including a 2015–2020 annual rate-of-change view.
why: Demonstrates applied data analysis, development context and the ability to turn a large cross-country dataset into an interpretable evidence story.

label: FLAGSHIP / IN DEVELOPMENT
title: Why Do Customers Leave?
short: A product analytics case study built around retention, behaviour and causal reasoning.
description: Planned flagship case combining SQL, Python, churn modelling, behavioural segmentation, causal analysis and a Power BI dashboard.
why: Designed to demonstrate the full product/customer analytics loop: measure → segment → predict → challenge → recommend.
